turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling customer service. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: MEMBER
turns.text: Hi, Sarah. Yeah, I'm calling because my monthly auto bill just seems too high lately. I'm trying to see if there's any way we can lower my payments on the Volvo EX30.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can certainly look into that for you and review your policy options. To get started, could I please have your first and last name?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Fanny. And can I get your member number, please?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Perfect. I have your account pulled up. I see the 2024 Volvo EX30 here with VIN number ERG2174639K. Let's take a look at your current coverages. All right. One option to lower your monthly premium without changing your deductibles is to remove the rental reimbursement coverage.

turns.speaker: MEMBER
turns.text: Okay. And how much would that save me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Removing that would drop your premium by about $15 a month. Just keep in mind, if we remove this and you are in an accident, the policy will no longer cover the cost of a rental car while your Volvo is in the shop. You would have to pay for a rental out of pocket.

turns.speaker: MEMBER
turns.text: Honestly, I work from home most of the week anyway, so if the car is in the shop, I can manage without a rental. Let's go ahead and take that off.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Completely understand. I will go ahead and process that endorsement for you right now. Your new monthly payment will be updated on your next billing cycle. Is there anything else I can adjust for you today?

turns.speaker: MEMBER
turns.text: No, that's exactly what I needed. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
